My passion for teaching stems from a love of language and culture, inspired by my high school friendships with exchange students. I was fascinated by their cultures and languages and tried, though largely unsuccessfully, to learn them all.

My methods are influenced by the groundbreaking work of Mike Long in Task-Based Language Teaching (TBLT) and backed by the latest research in Second Language Acquisition (SLA). Your Personalized Learning Plan will help you build confidence, fluency, and real-world skills, empowering you to thrive in business, education, and beyond.

You are not alone on this journey! I am here to guide you to success!
teacher_info.teaching_style:
Research in Second Language Acquisition overwhelmingly shows that personalized, task-based learning plans tailored to the unique needs of a learner are far superior to anything found in a textbook or syllabus based on a sequence of grammatical structures.

My lessons are 100% personalized to YOUR needs and goals. There are no "generic" lessons in your learning plan. Each lesson is designed based on your needs analysis, focusing on language, cultural contexts, and skills you need to succeed.

I appreciate your investment, time, and energy and want to see you make the most of this opportunity. Together, we will find the success you’ve been searching for!

I've had the opportunity to teach hundreds of students from a variety of countries, ranging from beginners to advanced/fluent. I have taught group lessons and private lessons. I do these corrections in British English and American English, depending on the student's preferred writing style. 

Finally, I spend most of my time abroad and am therefore familiar with the difficulties of communicating in a foreign language when you have not developed the necessary skills to communicate clearly and effectively. I am here to help you improve your communication skills so you can avoid the problems and awkward situations I have when doing business, traveling, or any other activity using a foreign language. course_info.trial_description:
Need an effective teacher who easily explains step by step?

This is a chance to practice your English skills, for me to assess your level, and for you to get an idea of my teaching style. 

You must be at least 6.5 years old for my class. For young beginners, we will introduce each other first, and l will teach you some common etiquette when meeting someone. Then I will show you some pictures where I will ask you some questions about them. I will also teach you  how to ask for help when you don' understand a word or don't have an answer. Next you will read  a short picture story with more question and answer time. Here I will get an an idea of your grammar experience and comprehension level. After that, we will play a learning game for you to learn some new vocabulary and demonstrate more speaking. Last, I will review the 44 sounds of the English language to see what sounds you are having trouble pronouncing. At the end, parents and I can meet to talk about strengths, weaknesses, and the best learning plan as well as further discounts.

If you are older we can talk and learn about anything you want or I will choose the topics.

Whether you are  a young or an adult, I will correct and explain all errors both verbally and in writing.

* SKYPE or Italki *  ( for 6.5-14 years old) This is an elementary level course  for kids who already know some phonics and can read short sentences. The goal is to build a strong  foundation to easily understand and speak on everyday topics for functioning in English-speaking cultures.

Conversations may include food, travel, school, hobbies, chores, dreams,  technology, trends, entertainment, health, traditions, shopping, pop culture, and more.


Through this class children get close 1 on 1 attention. 

Learners will:
-Read progressive picture stories both fiction and non-fiction (Biff & Chip, Raz Kids, Epic, news)

- Quickly build vocabulary and expressions

- Play fun learning games
- Master the 44 sounds of English for clear pronunciation
- Learn the 12 past, present, and future tenses
- Express experiences and opinions
- Compare and contrast

- Recognize spelling patterns

- Give show-and-tell presentations
- Take quizzes
- Do optional homework

If your goal is to  consistently improve your English,  make sure to schedule lessons regularly.

Engagement and frequency are the secrets to mastering English, and I will be there to help your child along.

pro_course_detail.title: The Simple Outline for Writing in English
pro_course_detail.description:
Create an informal but very useful outline for any writing project in English: emails,  essays, articles, speeches, work memos and more . A good outline helps you remember all the thoughts you want to write. This is especially true when you write in English which has such a huge vocabulary.

And no one is going to see your outline except you.  So, you don't have to be neat, put it onto a specific format, or concentrate on spelling or grammar.  An outline will benefit you no matter what your English level -  from intermediate to proficient.

In this class you'll learn:
*How to get over the dread of doing an outline.
* Why an outline works a lot better then memorizing ideas and details.
*The difference between a informal and academic outline.
* The wonderful fact that you don't have to follow your outline to successfully write. You can change your mind about what to write - or you can change your outline.

We'll start right away on your outline.  First you'll pick your writing topic.  Next, you'll write down your thoughts about what you want to communicate in your writing.  If you can't think of anything to write about, I'll interview you to find out your interests.  We'll then turn your outline into to a real piece of writing that you can use.

Class Expectations:
1. Keep a flexible mind when writing an outline and be open to ideas from me,  your teacher.
2. At the same time, prepare to write independently after a couple of sessions.
3. Expect homework on writing outlines or changing outlines into the final writing project.
4. Ask questions!

I look forward to having you in my class.
